trigger: The new acquisition controller required the no-index sentinel on the nested runtime directory even though the already approved v1.2 quarantine attaches that recursive control to an owner-private enclosing control directory.
permitted_change: Resolve the nearest owner-private enclosing directory, within at most five ancestors and outside the repository, that contains the owner-private .metadata_never_index sentinel. Require every directory from the runtime root through that control root to remain owner-private, non-symlinked, and outside the repository. Use the control root for namespace and free-space accounting.
